heading: **18 November 2025**
body:
*Optimising PE\_PCR for SELEX samples*

Each primer concentration needed \= 0.43 uM

18 uL reactions to be set up:

9 uL Phusion MasterMix  
1.55 uL 5 uM PE\_F  
1.55 uL 5 uM PE\_R

Set 1 ⇒ lig147  
Take 2 uL (\~40 ng) and dilute to 48 uL.  
Take 5.9 uL of this mix per tube of DNA.  
47.2 uL DNA \+ 72 uL Phusion MM \+ 12.4 uL PE\_F \+ 12.4 uL PE\_R

Gradient PCR ⇒ 55-60 degrees

Set 1 ⇒ ligN40w107  
Take 2 uL (\~40 ng) and dilute to 48 uL.  
Take 5.9 uL of this mix per tube of DNA.  
47.2 uL DNA \+ 72 uL Phusion MM \+ 12.4 uL PE\_F \+ 12.4 uL PE\_R

Gradient PCR ⇒ 55-60 degrees

| Step | Temp / ℃ | Time / s |
| :---: | :---: | :---: |
| 1 | 98 | 180 |
| 2 | 98 | 15 |
| 3 | 55-60 | 10 |
| 4 | 72 | 36 |
| 5 | GOTO 2 | X times |
| 6 | 72 | 120 |
| 7 | 25 | 2 |
| 8 | 4 | forever |

2 qPCR (3 NCAP-SELEX \+ 3 HT-SELEX)

| qPCR Plates |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reagents | per well in 384 | per 384-well plate | for 6 plates (x440) |
| NF water | 2.91 μL | 1.12 mL | 7.68 mL |
| 5x Phusion HF buffer | 1.25 μL | 480 μL | 3.3 mL |
| 10mM e dNTP | 0.25 μL | 96 μL | 660 μL |
| NCAP\_F 100μM  | 0.025 μL | 9.6 μL | 66 μL |
| NCAP\_R 100μM  | 0.025 μL | 9.6 μL | 66 μL |
| MgCl2 (50mM) | 0.0325 μL | 12.48 μL | 85.8 μL |
| Hot Start Phusion DNA Pol | 0.0375 μL | 14.4 μL | 99 μL |
| 100x SYBR (final 1:200) | 0.06 μL | 23.04 μL | 158.4 μL |
| Total | 4.59 μL | 1.765 mL | 12.1155 mL |

To prepare 100x SYBR Green: add 5μL 10,000x SYBR Green into 500μL DMSO, which can be found in Phusion DNA Pol kits. Avoid light.  
Manually load 122μL mix into each well of a 96-well plate (AB0765), then transfer 4.5μL/well into 6x 384-well plates (LightCycler 384). Repeat twice because of two ligands \- lig147, ligN40w107.
title: Optimising PE_PCR for SELEX samples
